zh.title: 聊天记录缺了一页，AI 恢复工作后会知道吗？
zh.summary: 一次恢复测试：删除中间事件后，剩下的记录还能读，但原始序号必须留下空洞。可继续工作，不等于历史完整。

en.title: A page is missing from the AI work log. Can it still resume?
en.summary: Delete an event in the middle and the survivors can still be read, while their original sequence retains a gap. Resumable is not the same as complete.
